We removed input validation to business logic and some other requirements to V50.8.

Chapter and section texts and titles still contain input validation. Need to move those pieces to correct place and re-read entire chapter.

comments.body: I think the Waiting for another should be vice versa. We need to make the changes first and then @csfreak92 can do the review part.

I submitted a PR to cleanup and complete the v11 section summaries. 

https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/pull/2606

The changes are brief, just to have something there for now.
@jmanico is there any remaining text from section V5.1 that should be migrated to V10.4, V11.3, or V50.8? The idea is that this section will entirely disappear.
I say drop all the text from 5.1 and I can write more minimalistic descriptions for V10.4, V11.3 and V50.8. Would you like me to do that now? Or are V10.4, V11.3, or V50.8 still in motion?

> I say drop all the text from 5.1 and I can write more minimalistic descriptions for V10.4, V11.3 and V50.8. Would you like me to do that now? Or are V10.4, V11.3, or V50.8 still in motion?

Make sure there is nothing important we are losing from there but yeah that sounds fine. In general the section text should explain the basic rationale for the section. I think you can update those sections.
@tghosth I am aiming to make the section descriptions a one sentence brief description. Let me PR my first cut and I'm happy to modify it, if you think its too brief.
AI one-liners are are not nice there. If there are no points to say, it can stay empty.

> AI one-liners are are not nice there. If there are no points to say, it can stay empty.

Agreed, I re-wrote them all carefully by hand to still be brief but more meaningful. Take a look. https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/pull/2606/files I also moved the v5 IV text into the IV section of business logic (in comments for now) until the move is complete.

My understanding is that we want all section summaries to be very brief, if you want this more verbose let me know.
Pinged @jmanico and @csfreak92 by email to check if there is any work in progress on this issue together with #2585.
We can close this out. If we need new chapter text we can open a  new issue or PR. Thanks all!
if you don't mind, I want to have one more look so I am going to keep this open to remind me :)
I understand what format you want for section summaries now. I'm happy to take it on for all sections if you want to assign anything to me.

title: V5 chapter texts - move input validation parts to correct place
